title: History of language models
done when: You can explain, in order, why n-grams gave way to RNNs and LSTMs, why seq2seq needed attention, and why the Transformer, scaling laws, RLHF, MoE, and reasoning models each followed.

title: Deep learning and transformer math
done when: You can derive backprop through softmax attention and compute, by hand, the FLOPs per token and the weight plus KV-cache memory of a 70B model.

title: Architecture variants
done when: Given any config.json you can name the variant: dense or MoE, MHA, GQA, or MLA, RoPE scaling, context length, and say what each choice costs at inference.
